goal: Implement R-001 WindowedAggregateNode with tumbling and sliding windows, event-time and processing-time semantics, and watermark integration.
requirements: Add WindowSpec for tumbling and sliding windows.
Use zero-allocation aggregation state with Agrona collections.
Support late-arrival policy for drop versus allow-lateness window.
Watermark advancement must drive window close.
constraints: Do not implement custom user-defined windows.
Do not implement session windows in this feature.
Window state is per-partition and never cross-partition.
acceptance_criteria: Unit tests cover tumbling windows, sliding windows, and late arrivals.
jmhSmokeCheck is green with the window node in benchmark surface.
